promise: Within 6-12 months, AI models will be capable of most, maybe all, end-to-end software engineering tasks
description: In a January 2026 interview Amodei predicted that within six to twelve months AI models could perform 'most, maybe all' of the end-to-end tasks currently handled by software engineers, and said he expected Nobel-level AI capability in multiple fields in 2026-2027. As of August 2026 the claim had not been demonstrated at scale.
evidence: Prediction made January 2026 with a 6-12 month window
No large-scale replacement of software engineers reported as of August 2026
